description.en: The ID of the inventory task.

description.zh: 搜索关键词，用于模糊匹配知识内容
description.en: The search keyword used for fuzzy matching against knowledge content.

description.zh: 知识展示类型筛选，如 TABLE、COLUMN、SQL、SEG、LINEAGE、TERM 等
description.en: The knowledge display type used to filter results, such as TABLE, COLUMN, SQL, SEG, LINEAGE, or TERM.
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values: confidence and entityId. Default value: confidence.

description.zh: 排序方向，可选值：asc（正序）、desc（倒序），默认desc
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:
- asc: ascending order.
- desc: descending order.

Default value: desc.

title.zh: 获取盘点资产的异步接口
title.en: Submit an asynchronous export task for inventory assets

descriptions.zh: 按与 SearchInventoryKnowledge / ExportInventoryKnowledge 相同的筛选条件提交异步导出任务，接口立即返回 exportTaskId（status=RUNNING）。后台生成 XLSX 并上传 OSS 后，通过 GetInventoryExportTaskStatus 轮询；status=SUCCESS 时返回预签名 downloadUrl。无需 Size/Offset，单次最多导出 50000 条。
descriptions.en: Submits an asynchronous export task by using the same filter conditions as SearchInventoryKnowledge or ExportInventoryKnowledge. The operation immediately returns an exportTaskId with status=RUNNING. After the XLSX file is generated and uploaded to OSS in the background, poll the task status by calling GetInventoryExportTaskStatus. When status=SUCCESS, a pre-signed downloadUrl is returned. Size and Offset are not required. A maximum of 50,000 records can be exported in a single request.
